## 4201f3b3ea1b

**Reproduced teaching ambiguity: local-only motif shortcut.** Audited generator SHA-256 `a16fbd1baf544d3a435d9371e573855ac6a88359c22dc108439d770bdde0513b`, rule hash `d92ee10172c2`.

For difficulty `easy`, seed `1`, start index `1`, the five production profiles are `four_anchors`, `extra_source_marker`, `single_cell_motif`, `public_train_2`, and query `disconnected_wide_motif`. A plausible rival treats only non-`{0,5,6}` cells within Chebyshev radius two of the first color-5 source marker as the motif, then stamps those cells at the color-6 anchors. That rival matches all four demonstrations and changes the fifth pair’s answer.

The held-out input passes the target’s `self_check`. The supported `arcpuzzles apply` receipt executes canonical rule `d92ee10172c2`; its output matches the target’s mirror and differs from the rival. Thus this is an exact production-domain lesson ambiguity rather than a Python-only disagreement. `checks/audit/4201f3b3ea1b/counterexample.json` contains source/rule hashes, seed/index, profiles, fit vector, validator result, output hashes, commands, and paths to the input, Racket receipt, mirror, and rival grids. The complete five-pair lesson is `checks/audit/4201f3b3ea1b/local_motif_lesson.json`.

The combined audit also found no declared semantic contract and could not run the target’s own tests because its root fixture has the same fixed-depth portable-path defect. Those tool findings do not create the counterexample, but they explain why the shortcut was not automatically rejected.

Suggested repair, not implemented: declare the local-motif rival and schedule at least one far or disconnected motif cell into every complete demonstration set; make `lesson_identifiable` reject a lesson whenever that rival survives and changes the query. Move future tests to portable root helpers. No target files were modified.
